trust_decision.summary: Raw embed HTML pasted into the Embed modal is trusted: submitSRC adopts the DOMParser fragment as-is, and #create re-creates any sibling <script src> as a fresh live script element and appends it to the figure cover, so an attacker-chosen external script executes in the editor origin; every other content route strips <script> (script is listed as disallowed in the editor's default extra-tag map).

landing_point.why: Reading only the summary ('DOM XSS via External Script Element After Iframe Embed'), the first thing to inspect is where the embed plugin builds a script element from the pasted fragment; that is the only script element construction in src/.

fix_sites.entry_point: plugin option scriptSrcWhitelist consumed by #create on submit
Embed modal submit (embed.js:339) and public embed.submitSRC(html) (types/plugins/modal/embed.d.ts:294)
published type declarations for the new option

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names the Embed plugin, so the Video plugin's raw-iframe route reads as a separate feature that intentionally accepts arbitrary video URLs and never re-creates a script element.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The plugin deliberately re-creates the provider's script so a Twitter/Instagram blockquote embed loads widgets.js; a blanket 'drop every script' fix breaks that flow, and the pinned suite also asserts that a raw <iframe src="https://example.com/embed"> is accepted (that test line is what the published fix had to change).

O6_input_shapes: raw fragment whose first element is <iframe ...> (each top-level iframe src validated)
iframes nested inside any top-level element of the fragment (querySelectorAll('iframe'))
raw fragment whose first element is <blockquote ...>
sibling top-level <script src=...> gated against the whitelist
inline <script> with no src always rejected
whitelist entry shapes: RegExp (tested against the full src) and string (startsWith)
whitelist absent or non-array -> defaults to [] so all scripts are rejected

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The Video plugin accepts pasted raw <iframe ...></iframe> code, keeps only its src, and inserts a new iframe with that src through create() with no URL/content-type whitelist and no script gate.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The advisory is about the Embed plugin; Video exists to embed arbitrary video URLs and its path never creates a script element, so it looks like a neighbouring feature rather than the reported sink.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same directory, different plugin file (1 file from the landing point)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A <script src> nested inside an appended child (e.g. inside the <blockquote> of a tweet payload, or inside a sibling <div>/<svg>) is attached wholesale by appendChild at embed.js:612 and never reaches #isAllowedScriptSrc; only direct children of the parsed fragment are gated.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The documented raw-embed shape is a blockquote plus a sibling script, so scripts inside the provider's own markup look like part of that markup rather than the reported vector; and the fix added nesting checks for iframes but not for scripts.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same function as the fix (no distance)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The iframe-placeholder re-render path rebuilds an iframe from serialized JSON attributes with only an on*-attribute filter and a protocol-only _isSafeURL check, not the embed URL whitelist.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same maintainer already hardened this copy/paste path (on* attributes and unsafe protocols are filtered here today), so extending the embed whitelist to it is a natural sibling of the same protection.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second raw-<iframe> embed parser in the Video plugin.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the same user gesture (paste embed code) and the same iframe sink, and the plugin already has its own #checkContentType used by component()/retainFormat, so reusing a whitelist here is a plausible maintainer edit.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Per-instance urlPatterns/embedQuery config is flattened into the static Embed.#urlPatterns that both component() and the new iframe check read.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A host that registers custom embed services plausibly also registers a scriptSrcWhitelist; wiring both through the shared static is realistic because the static is already overwritten by every Embed constructor.

O9_family: DOM-based cross-site scripting (CWE-79), script injection into editor content
